selectionEntries.comment:
LOADOUT UI: the nested Nob occupies the conceptual model-1 position when selected. Ork Boyz 2-6 are the ordinary Choppa + Slugga models. Boyz 7-8 are the paid special-weapon slots and Boy 9 is the paid advanced-weapon slot. Because these are paid upgrades, each specialist slot retains its ordinary Slugga state.
ATTACHMENT VALIDATION: the nested Nob and attached Painboy share the ordinary attachment point. Warboss associations remain outside that point as permitted by their rule. Painboy candidate filtering is preserved, while constructive errors cover duplicate Painboys and the reverse-order Nob + Painboy state.

modifiers.value: Ork Boyz has more than one Painboy attached. It may have only one Painboy attached. Remove or move one of the attached Painboys.
Ork Boyz cannot include both a Nob and an attached Painboy. Remove the Nob or remove/move the Painboy.

catalogue.comment:
COMPLETE LOADOUT + VARIABLE SIZE + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
Orks now use the final-state 'fancy notepad' loadout grammar. Nested Nob/Kommando Nob mechanics and Painboy-root attachment logic are preserved. Nobz and Deffkoptas use variable-size controls. All native non-Rare Other units use Additional Copy Costs.

KOMMANDO SPECIAL-WEAPON CORRECTION
Removed the vestigial 'each with a different weapon' restriction from Kommando specialist models. Kommando 7-9 may now select duplicate special weapons. Deff Dread four-list structure confirmed: two mixed melee/ranged lists and two melee-only lists.

CONSTRUCTIVE ERROR MIGRATION
Orks now use Game System revision 11. Additional Copy Costs, mandatory root Leader attachments, the shared WARBOSS limit, and the Ork Boyz Painboy/Nob attachment point use constructive player-facing validation. Nested Nob and Kommando Nob structures, Kommando duplicate specialist weapons, variable-size units, loadouts, points, and Additional Copy Costs arithmetic are otherwise unchanged.

REV5 NEW RECRUIT EXPORT COMPATIBILITY
Updated to Warhammer 40k Reforged Game System revision 12. All Points cost references now use New Recruit's canonical Warhammer 40,000 cost-type identifier 51b2-306e-1021-d207. No unit costs, loadouts, validation, Leader behavior, Rare limits, categories, or Additional Copy Costs arithmetic were otherwise changed.
